rules.title: Group rules
rules.subtitle: Understand how scoring and participation work
rules.deadlinesBody: Tournament enrollment opens when its status is “Coming up”. Predictions can be submitted from the moment the draw is published on TennisPool until the start of the first main-draw match.
rules.editBody: You can change your predictions as often as you like until lock time (tournament start). After matches begin, predictions are frozen and can no longer be edited.
rules.scoringBody: You earn points for every correct winner. Scoring is progressive: later rounds are worth more. The Final awards points only to those who pick the tournament Champion.
rules.bracketBody: Pick who advances through every stage, predicting the bracket all the way to the final, and earn progressive points to climb the rankings.
rules.viewOthersBody: To view opponents' predictions, go to "Ranking", then "Tournament Ranking", open a tournament and pick an opponent.
rules.importantBody: Whenever a player with Lucky Loser (LL) status wins a match, or in case of a W/O (Walkover) win, no points are awarded.
rules.tiebreakIntro: If two or more participants finish with the same total points, the following criteria apply in order:
rules.tiebreak3: Highest total number of correct match winners;
rules.tiebreak4: Highest overall ranking score (points accumulated across stages);
rules.generalComposed: The overall ranking is made up of <bold>29 official tournaments</bold>, distributed as follows:
rules.generalValid: A total of <bold>29 tournaments</bold> are valid for scoring.
rules.generalScoring1: In each tournament played, the participant will accumulate points according to their performance.
rules.generalScoring2: The overall ranking will be calculated based on the 22 best scores obtained among the 29 available tournaments.
rules.generalScoring3: Points will be counted on a 52-week system (12 rolling months).
rules.generalScoring4: The overall ranking will be updated only at the end of each tournament.
rules.validity1: Every score earned in a tournament is valid for 52 weeks from the date of the competition.
rules.validity2: After this period, the points for that tournament are automatically reset to zero and no longer count toward the ranking.
rules.validity3: The system will continuously update the ranking, always considering the 22 highest valid scores within the current period.
